note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(Animals 主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: A young elephant once fell into a deep mud pit and could not climb out on its own. Workers from a nearby rescue centre spent the whole afternoon gently digging away the mud and pulling it free. By evening the tired but healthy elephant walked back to its herd, and the rescuers felt proud that their patient effort had saved a life.

questions.q: Why could the young elephant not get out of the pit?
options: It had sunk deep into the mud and was unable to get out by itself.
It was too lazy to move.
It was tied to a tree.
It was asleep in the pit.
questions.explanation: 原文 'fell into a deep mud pit and could not climb out on its own' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: How did the rescuers feel by the end of the day?
options: Angry that they had wasted time.
Proud that their patient work had rescued the young animal.
Sorry they had started the rescue.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that their patient effort had saved a life'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
